entry.title: the environment named is not declared
entry.what: A verb was given an environment that goatbuilder.yaml (or goatlite.yaml) does not declare in environments:. Nothing runs against an environment nobody declared.
causes: the environment is declared in another checkout's goatbuilder.yaml
fixes: the names declared are listed in the message; pass one of them
add the environment to ops/goatbuilder/goatbuilder.yaml environments:
